title: End-to-End CSV Pipeline & NumPy-Pandas Integration Simulator
description: Trace the full data engineering lifecycle: reading raw CSV text, vectorized feature synthesis, conditional priority labeling with np.where(), categorical aggregation, descending ranking, NumPy array interop, and exporting to clean CSV.

steps.title: Parse In-Memory CSV Stream
steps.explanation: Pandas parses the tabular text stream, automatically recognizing row 0 as header column names ['OrderID', 'Product', 'Category', 'Price', 'Quantity'] and inferring numerical float/int datatypes.

steps.title: Vectorized Revenue Synthesis
steps.explanation: Pandas evaluates element-wise vector multiplication across Price and Quantity series simultaneously in C-speed without Python loops, producing total order amounts.

steps.title: Conditional Vectorization: np.where()
steps.explanation: NumPy's vectorized ternary conditional evaluates the boolean mask. Orders >= 30,000 receive 'Express', while smaller orders receive 'Standard' without any Python if-else loops.

steps.title: Category Aggregation via GroupBy
steps.explanation: The Split-Apply-Combine engine partitions rows into Electronics and Furniture buckets, summing the revenue for each sector: Electronics=155,250.0 and Furniture=33,000.0.

steps.title: Descending Rank Sorting & Index Reset
steps.explanation: Orders are arranged from greatest to smallest revenue. reset_index(drop=True) establishes a crisp 0-to-5 sequential rank order.

steps.title: NumPy Array Extraction: to_numpy()
steps.explanation: Strips DataFrame labels, indices, and series metadata to produce a high-performance, contiguous C-memory 2D float64 NumPy ndarray of shape (6, 3) ready for linear algebra.

steps.title: NumPy Matrix to DataFrame Reconstruction
steps.explanation: Demonstrates bidirectional interop: wraps the raw ndarray back into an indexed, labeled 2D DataFrame with explicit column headings.

steps.title: Exporting to Persistent CSV
steps.explanation: Serializes the analyzed tabular data into standard RFC 4180 CSV string format. index=False prevents writing extraneous row numbers '0, 1, 2...' into the destination file.
